row.title: Growth metrics read through the site Worker, not a token in Actions
row.body: GROWTH-HITS-1 (2026-11-25, Session: session_0156nqDvJ5oNPSCVZzS8cYKL): the Cloudflare token never reached Actions, so growth metrics were empty for days. The site Worker already binds the analytics D1, so it serves the four 7-day aggregates at /api/growth/hits and foundation/growth.py falls back to it when no token is present. No credential crosses into Actions.

title: Growth metrics read through the site Worker, not a token in Actions
